verdict.rationale: The IRS documents Modernized e-File as an XML system-to-system transmission channel open to Authorized IRS e-file Providers. It also publishes the provider enrollment path, including an approval window of up to 45 days and a fingerprinting requirement for some principals. IRIS separately offers an Application to Application (A2A) intake channel gated by a Transmitter Control Code. Missing for 10: a documented application path for the IRIS A2A Transmitter Control Code, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the enrollment process.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published

citations.quote: MeF uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format.
it can take up to 45 days from the date of submission for the IRS to approve your e-file application
receives information through two intake channels: IRIS Taxpayer Portal/UI and IRIS Application to Application (A2A)
